---
title: "Data browser"
description: >
  Explore spatial gene expression, cell type proportions, ESV scores and PoPS
  disease scores interactively.
---

Select a dataset, a gene and a cell type to view the spatial expression of that
gene alongside the spatial abundance of that cell type, together with the ESV
score for the pair. Choosing `whole` shows the expression map on its own.
Selecting a disease additionally reports the PoPS score of the selected gene for
that disease.

## Notes

- **Normalised count** is the log-normalised expression stored with each dataset.
  Values are transferred as 8-bit quantities scaled to each gene's own maximum,
  so plotted values are accurate to roughly 0.2% of that maximum — ample for the
  colour map, but read the tiles rather than the plot when you need exact numbers.
- **Cell type proportion** is the estimated proportion of the selected cell type
  at each spot; the proportions across all cell types sum to one at every spot.
- **ESV** is the expression-based spatial variability score for the selected
  gene within the selected cell type, as reported by `spacelink()` and
  `spacelink_ctSVG()`.
- **PoPS** scores come from the Polygenic Priority Score tables and are defined
  per gene and per trait; they do not depend on the dataset or the cell type.
  Genes absent from the PoPS tables are reported as such.
- Spatial plots use the same orientation as the package vignettes (the vertical
  axis is reversed) and are drawn with an equal aspect ratio.
